Thirteen methods in the `tokio` crate call `trace::async_op` directly. I searched the workspace for every use of the name and matched each call site to the method around it. All the calls are in `tokio/src/sync/` and `tokio/src/time/`. The other places that mention `async_op` only use it as a span name (`"runtime.resource.async_op"`) and don't call the function. Those are `oneshot.rs` (`Receiver`), `time/sleep.rs`, `batch_semaphore.rs` and the tracing tests.
